title: The Paddle Games Got a Notifications Inbox

paragraphs: Built a new notifications service for The Paddle Games. Less work than I expected. The infrastructure was already there. Every badge award and rank improvement was publishing to Pub/Sub. I just needed something listening, writing into a Firestore subcollection per user.
Badges, rank improvements, announcements. The bell icon in the nav lights up when there's something new.
If you paddle (SUP, kayak, canoe, surf, row), connect your Strava account and join at thepaddlegames.com.
